cases.note: mod/ tree with modinfo.lua and modmain.lua, no symbolic links or native modules, parseable Lua

cases.id: case:sentinel: the compost pile is available on the server
case:the compost pile recipe costs the configured rocks, logs and manure
case:a pile needs at least three items before it composts
cases.note: Composter:CanCompost with two and three twigs.

cases.id: case:a small batch takes three days to become compost
cases.note: Time advanced with LongUpdate; HARVEST availability observed through CollectActions.

cases.id: case:a finished pile reports that it is done when inspected
case:harvesting a finished small batch hands over two manure
cases.note: The HARVEST action runs under pcall so the starter's later error does not hide the manure count.

cases.id: case:harvesting with fireflies attracted completes and the pile can be refilled
case:a rich batch that makes the soil fertile starts composting
case:the rotten-food bonus of one batch is not paid again on the next
cases.note: Three carrots at 20% then three twigs.

cases.id: case:a composting pile that is saved and reloaded finishes on time
cases.note: Guards against dropping the remaining time on load.

cases.id: case:a finished pile still offers its harvest after a save and reload
case:setup: an empty pile is saved and reloaded
case:an empty pile stays empty and usable after a save and reload

known_issues: Upstream Harvest uses the poop stack to size the rot stack and never registers its meat recipe; the suite avoids meat batches. This is upstream behaviour in both starter and reference and is not part of the task.
The inspection status is asserted through the inspectable component's GetStatus key (DONE, COMPOSTING_FERTILE), not the rendered string; the exam names the keys.
